// faq

Questions, answered.

What does XBD do?

XBD (Xplore Brand Differently) is a digital growth agency in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We provide social media marketing, SEO, graphic design, website design and development, content creation, branding and video editing.

Who do you work with?

Startups, growing businesses, education and training providers, non-profits and agencies in Bangladesh, the UK and the USA — and anywhere else we can work with you remotely.

How much does it cost?

Static design and video editing have published starting prices (see Packages). Websites, SEO, social media marketing and branding are quoted after a short discovery call, based on your goals and scope.

How do we get started?

Send us a message on WhatsApp or through the form below. We’ll ask about your goals, share a clear scope, timeline and quote, and start once you approve.

How long does a project take?

It depends on scope. You get a clear schedule in the quote before we start, and regular check-ins while we work.

Can I see examples of your work?

Yes — see Selected Work above. We’re happy to share more examples that match your industry on request.

Do you work with clients outside Bangladesh?

Yes. Our team works remotely with clients in Bangladesh, the UK and the USA, in English and Bangla.
